questions.q: What do bees carry from flower to flower that helps plants make fruit and seeds?
questions.fact: Pollen! When pollen moves from one flower to another, the plant can grow fruit and seeds. That's called pollination.

questions.q: Where does a honeybee carry pollen home?
choices: In baskets on its back legs
questions.fact: Pollen baskets! Honeybees pack pollen into little baskets on their back legs and fly it home to feed baby bees.

questions.q: Which of these foods needs bees to pollinate it?
questions.fact: Almonds! Almond trees need bees, and beekeepers bring huge numbers of hives to almond orchards every spring. Rice and wheat are pollinated by the wind.

questions.q: About how many bites of our food depend on pollinators like bees?
questions.fact: About 1 in 3! Fruits, veggies, and nuts that bees and other pollinators help grow make up about a third of what we eat.
